Title: Azure Functions custom handlers are now generally available

Body.Content:
By building custom handlers, you can use your favorite language or runtime—such as Go, Rust, and PHP—in Azure Functions. Custom handlers allow you develop serverless, event-driven applications and take advantage of all available Azure Functions triggers and bindings.

Read our announcement blog post for more details and try the custom handlers quickstarts in Microsoft Docs.
